title: nephrodium filix-mas subsp. borreri
intro: Nephrodium filix-mas subsp. borreri, commonly known as the intermediate polypody fern, is a subspecies of fern found in various regions, particularly in Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant has been utilized for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in managing conditions like arthritis and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium filix-mas subsp. borreri include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
